provenance.droppedFromEnvelope: The streaming events, tool results (the checkout's file contents), the init line beyond version and model, and the --json-schema argument value (it is the schema above). Each call keeps its result line verbatim (resultLineVerbatim), the last line of its stream, with one replacement made 2026-10-15: the local path of the session scratchpad in each permission_denials file_path (it named the operator's user directory) is written <session-scratchpad>. rawStream.sha256 describes the stream before that replacement.
provenance.doesNotShow: Two samples of one small prompt. They do not show how often a schema-bound reply fails, what Claude Code does when a reply fails the schema, how a reply carrying tens of kilobytes of file content behaves (crew-chatter run 3's 64 KB phase reply), or whether a schema-bound reply can still return an unchanged file (a schema cannot express 'changed'). Nor does it show a schema-bound dispatch that actually read the checkout: every Read was denied (permissionDenials).
provenance.permissionDenials: Correction recorded 2026-10-14 after capture: in both calls the result line lists one permission denial, the model's Read of index.html in its own clone. The model never read the checkout; the toolCallsInOrder entry Read is the denied attempt. The clones were under the session scratchpad inside the system temp directory (AppData/Local/Temp/claude/...); the run's own phase 2 dispatch, launched in a worktree under the testing-repos directory, recorded no denials. Why the Read was denied is not established.
